title: Warm Fluffy Croatian Egg Frittata
description: A savory and aerated Croatian dish featuring instant yeast and bonito flakes, perfect for brunch, this frittata is a raw-friendly and delicious meal option.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, instant yeast, salt, and black pepper until well combined.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the bowl and stir until the vegetables are evenly distributed.
Heat the olive oil in a 10-inch oven-safe skillet over medium heat.
Pour the egg mixture into the skillet and cook for 2 minutes, until the edges start to set.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15 minutes, until the frittata is puffed and golden brown.
Remove the skillet from the oven and sprinkle the shaved bonito flakes over the top of the frittata.
Return the skillet to the oven and bake for an additional 1 minute, until the bonito flakes are crispy.
